premises.text: H-2A seasonal labor is essential for U.S. farms but brings heavy regulation and paperwork requiring person-and-place tracking for compliance
premises.evidence_span: without this program, farmers can't survive because they have no labor. But being that it's a government program, it's also heavily regulated. And with heavy regulations comes heavy paperwork

premises.text: Most farms still track labor with pen and paper, making accurate compliance impractical and audits often find violations
premises.evidence_span: 84% of farms today are still tracking everything with pen and paper. They haven't digitized yet

premises.text: AgriTrack digitizes farm labor data (who/what/when/where) via dashboard, field tablet with NFC clock-in, and geotagged phone apps built by a grower for growers
premises.evidence_span: AgriTrack captures the most vital data that farmers need, which is labor. In other words, who is doing what, when, and where. And we digitize the whole process

premises.text: Labor audit reports and automated piece-rate/hourly/overtime payroll calculations keep farms DOL-ready and cut payroll from a day to minutes
premises.evidence_span: the labor audit report. It's named that way for a reason, because it has everything that's in step with the Department of Labor

premises.text: Future modules will extend tracking to food traceability and spray records beyond the labor component
premises.evidence_span: that is just with the labor component. In the future, there's food traceability modules, spray record modules

value.text: Farms collect accurate labor data and stay confidently compliant when DOL audits
value.evidence_span: farms can utilize AgriTrack to have confidence in the data that they're collecting, knowing that it's accurate, and that if the Department of Labor comes knocking, they feel okay

secondary_value.text: Large time savings running payroll anywhere
secondary_value.evidence_span: what used to take a day or more to run payroll and do that process is now actually being done in minutes with AgriTrack

causal_links.evidence_span: it's really difficult to stay compliant when you're recording everything with pen and paper
AgriTrack helps solve this problem by digitizing the whole process
download that report, give it to them, and they're ready to go
Everything that farmers are going to have to track can be found in AgriTrack
